attendanceRate30d_dropping.description: Schedule a home visit to understand recent absences
attendanceRate30d_dropping.rationale: Attendance trend reversal is most effective when addressed early

householdIncomeShock.description: Assess eligibility for DSWD AICS emergency assistance
householdIncomeShock.rationale: Income shock is a documented dropout precursor
householdIncomeShock.dswdProgramReference: DSWD Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS)

hasOlderSiblingDropout.description: Engage family on educational continuity; reference older sibling's experience
hasOlderSiblingDropout.rationale: Sibling dropout patterns indicate household-level factors

gradeTrend_negative.description: Coordinate with school guidance counselor for academic catch-up support
gradeTrend_negative.rationale: Grade decline often signals untreated learning gap

recentRelocation.description: Verify enrollment continuity and connect family to new school's guidance office
recentRelocation.rationale: Relocation disrupts continuity and increases dropout risk

ageGradeMismatch.description: Identify learning gap source; coordinate remedial support with school
ageGradeMismatch.rationale: Age-grade mismatch reflects accumulated unaddressed challenges

failingSubjects.description: Connect family to subject-specific tutoring or peer learning groups

recentComplianceWarnings.description: Discuss compliance warnings with family to understand barriers
recentComplianceWarnings.rationale: Compliance issues often signal underlying household stress

attendanceTrend_negative.description: Conduct a check-in home visit to understand emerging attendance concerns
attendanceTrend_negative.rationale: Declining attendance trend is an early signal requiring prompt follow-up

distanceToSchoolKm_high.description: Explore transportation assistance options with the school and local LGU
distanceToSchoolKm_high.rationale: Long distance to school is a documented barrier to consistent attendance
